what: ROADMAP PR 1, round 2 (2026-11-20): SockCast, a deliberately nonsensical three-screen app (S01 Forecast, S02 Sock detail, S03 Sock settings) with an Approved box per screen and the markup legend with its Send box, drawn by the agent; the person marked it up in a real tab and sent the round with the Send box (ADR-007). Kept: the person's two review marks, a red loop round the whole of S03 and an orange loop round S02, and an orange stroke that was a missed attempt at ticking Send.
why: The second round a person marked up, and the first sent with the Send box. Both review marks bind where the person said they meant them (asked after the round): S03 'change', S02 'remove'. The stroke across the Send box's corner is no review mark; the reading lists no annotation for it, though the change report attached it to s01-sock-2 (a finding of the round, DEVLOG 2026-11-20 (f)).
notes: Drawn 2026-11-20 on port 3011 (in memory): the screens, boxes and legend by `apply`, the marks in the browser pane, exported with `excalidraw-canvas export` after the round was sent. The person's random ids were renamed ring-s03, ring-s02 and send-try.

Left out: the person's tick inside the Send box (deleted by the reset, as `watch --until-sent` does), and a green dot drawn after the reset, which belongs to the next round and was held from the reading live.

Before ticking, the person moved the Send box a few pixels, trying to tick with the selection tool; the legend here carries that move. The report also had the legend's example check mark 'moved down 7px' by the person: that was the tab re-basing a line whose first point was not the origin, not the person (T-031, found 2026-11-20 after the round).
